CVH-COMPACT-FEEDBACK-AND-TOOLTIP-REMOVAL.title: Immediate in-chat feedback for Compact Context and removal of tooltip on 'Сжать контекст' button
CVH-COMPACT-FEEDBACK-AND-TOOLTIP-REMOVAL.author: agent-developer (tauri-rust-engineer & react-tailwind-artisan)
CVH-COMPACT-FEEDBACK-AND-TOOLTIP-REMOVAL.summary: Removed disruptive native browser tooltip from 'Сжать контекст' button in DrawerSteerBar and implemented immediate optimistic in-chat feedback for context compaction. Synchronized deterministic tool_id between React drawerStore and Rust backend compact_context command, broadcasting agent:tool_call at start, updating with execution duration and token savings badge (-X токенов) upon completion, and persisting under the exact same ID in SQLite dialog_items table to eliminate duplicate cards or UI flicker on dialog reload. Refactored ContextGauge to reuse compactTaskContext.

CVH-MODEL-OVERRIDE-COMPACTION-POLICY-SYN.title: Preserve task model override across lifecycles, set auto-compaction strictly at 100% context_window, and auto-sync tool policies to persona.md
CVH-MODEL-OVERRIDE-COMPACTION-POLICY-SYN.commitMessage: feat(tasks): preserve task model override, fix compaction threshold, and sync tool policies
CVH-MODEL-OVERRIDE-COMPACTION-POLICY-SYN.author: agent-developer (tauri-rust-engineer)
CVH-MODEL-OVERRIDE-COMPACTION-POLICY-SYN.summary: Fixed task model reset bug by accepting and persisting model in create_task, adding update_task command, inheriting parent_model in create_subtask, and reloading fresh tasks from disk in run_agent. Changed auto-compaction threshold to trigger strictly at current_tokens >= context_window (100%). Added sync_tool_policies_to_personas to auto-reconcile tool policy matrix with persona.md frontmatter.

CVH-OPTIMISTIC-TASK-LATENCY.title: Optimistic Task Creation & Deletion Latency on Kanban Board and React.memo Optimization
CVH-OPTIMISTIC-TASK-LATENCY.commitMessage: fix(board): auto-unlock parent on subtask deletion and reconcile drifting subtask id
CVH-OPTIMISTIC-TASK-LATENCY.author: agent-developer (react-tailwind-artisan & tauri-rust-engineer)
CVH-OPTIMISTIC-TASK-LATENCY.summary: Eliminated Kanban board task creation and deletion latency (<1ms) via optimistic Zustand state updates and fine-grained React.memo rendering optimizations. 1. boardStore.addTask: Generates monotonic task ID and immediately displays optimistic task card on board before awaiting backend IPC, then silently reconciles confirmed ID and worktreePath. 2. boardStore.createSubtask: Optimistically creates subtasks and updates parent status to 'waiting_subtask' without full disk reloads (loadTasks), updating parent waitingForSubtaskId if subtask ID drifted. 3. boardStore.deleteTask & tasks.rs: Optimistically removes task and cascaded subtasks from state (<1ms) and auto-unlocks parent tasks waiting on deleted subtasks. Added delete_task IPC command with scoped mutex drops, active agent abort, worktree/branch cleanup, SQLite dialog purge, and state/disk synchronization. 4. React rendering: Wrapped KanbanCard and KanbanColumn in React.memo with custom shallow comparators (areCardPropsEqual, areColumnPropsEqual), replaced wholesale useBoardStore subscriptions with atomic selective subscriptions and useShallow, and stabilized KanbanBoard handlers with useCallback.
